dropped.item: Cancellation condition: auto-renewal can be avoided by canceling at least 24 hours before the end of the current period (the deadline for canceling is gone)
Subscription can be managed or canceled 'anytime'
Premium unlocks more of what the app offers (the edit no longer says what upgrading gives you)
Purpose of the videos: seeing proper form and technique for each movement
Reminders are set on a schedule that fits your day
'So you always know what to do and how to do it right'

changed.item: Renewal terms: 'renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period' became 'will automatically renew within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period'. This changes a cancellation deadline into a statement about when renewal happens.
Disclaimer: 'not a substitute for professional medical advice' became 'not intended to provide medical advice'
Consultation advice: 'before starting any exercise program' became 'before performing an exercise', which is a different scope
Sharing: the PT can see your progress (and adjust your plan) became you send progress 'to improve your treatment plan', which shifts both the mechanism and who acts
'Download and get started at no cost' became 'free to download and use', which implies ongoing free use rather than a free starting point
Subscription management is now available 'after purchase' rather than 'anytime'

added.item: 'Never miss a session again', an absolute promise not in the original
Premium 'will be charged to your Apple ID account'
